messages.author: f3e8911d01fbf32d
messages.subject: subset MSImagingExperiment object
parts:
Hi Cardinal user,

I want to subset MSImagingExperiment object with the condition, for instance that the intensity of m/z 1200 is higher than 300.

Here is my example code. The mse data is from cardinal tutorial data.

## get row index corresponding to m/z 1200, and subset mse
F1200 <- features(mse, mz = 1200)
mse1200 <- mse[F200, ]

## get the intensity of m/z 1200
Int1200 = as.matrix(mse1200@imageData$data$intensity)
Int1200_sub = Int1200[Int1200 > 300]

Then I don't know how to subset the mse1200 data. Could someone help?

Thanks a lot.

Hu

messages.author: db2a70d9b31cb1f7
messages.subject: Re: subset MSImagingExperiment object
parts:
Hi Hu,

your code is all fine, the only problem is that there is no intensity above 300:

range(Int1200) # maximum is 0.529
Int1200_sub = Int1200[Int1200 > 0.5] # you could choose 0.5 as cutoff
## depending on your aim, you might be more flexible by creating a logical vector:
Int1200_sub = Int1200 > 0.5

Hope that helps,
Melanie
